isdn: isdn — Isdenu, a god of the tribunal that judges the dead; perhaps a form of the name of Isdes (?) (god's name; Budge: Àsṭennu)
itrty: itrty — the Two Shrines, the national shrines of Upper and Lower Egypt, standing for the gods of the whole land (noun f., dual; Budge: àterti, 'the two regions')
mnty: mnty — the condemned (?) (noun, plural; with the classifier of enemies; sense uncertain; Budge: menta, 'those who are annihilated')
nḏm: nḏm — to be sweet, pleasant (verb; nḏm ib 'glad of heart'; Budge: net'em)
sft: sft — to slaughter, butcher (verb; Budge: sefet)
sštꜣ: sštꜣ — to hide, make secret (verb; causative of štꜣ 'be secret'; Budge: seśeta)
wp-wꜣwt: wp-wꜣwt — Wepwawet, 'Opener of the Ways', a jackal god (god's name; Budge: Àp-uat)
ḏrw: ḏrw — side, flank (?) (noun; perhaps from ḏr 'limit, end'; Budge: t'eruu, 'heel')
ꜥwt: ꜥwt — small cattle, flocks, goats and sheep (noun f., collective; Budge: āut, 'animals')

__broaden__.mnt: mnt — daily (adverb; Budge: ment) · a second word of the same spelling: thigh, leg (?) (noun f.; with the leg as classifier; Budge: ment, 'leg')
__broaden__.ḏr: ḏr — limit, border, end (noun) · also 'since, when' (conjunction before a verb form: ḏr wnn·f 'since he was') · also ḏri 'to put an end to, stop' (?) (verb; Budge: t'erà)
__broaden__.ḫr: ḫr — to fall (verb) · a second word of the same spelling: to, near, with (preposition; of persons) · also 'before' (ḫr nṯrw 'before the gods') · a third word: the particle ḫr, which brings in a further case or a consequence (?) (particle; sometimes written ẖr)
__broaden__.·f: ·f — he, him, his, it (3rd person masculine singular suffix pronoun; the horned viper) · after a dual noun sometimes followed by the two strokes of the dual, which are not read (ꜥwy·f 'his two arms')
__broaden__.bꜣby: bꜣby — Babi, a savage baboon god who devours the condemned (god's name; Budge: Baabi) · also written bby, without the vulture (Budge: Bebi)
__broaden__.ḥr: ḥr — face; (preposition) upon, on, over, concerning · a second word of the same spelling: Horus, the falcon god, son of Osiris and Isis; the sun as a falcon (god's name; Budge: Ḥeru) · also 'at' (ḥr sbꜣw 'at the gates'); ḥr-tp 'upon' (compound preposition: ḥr + tp 'head') · also for, on behalf of; on account of (preposition; ḥr·k 'for you') · also 'with' (of the cause of a feeling: ḥtp ḥr·s 'content with it')
__broaden__.iry: iry — one who belongs to, keeper of (nisba of r "to"; iry ꜥꜣ "doorkeeper") · also as an adjective, 'belonging to, pertaining to' (feminine irt; irt·f 'which belongs to him')
